artifacts.name: .next
artifacts.clean: delete the directory; Next.js has no dedicated project clean command

artifacts.name: .nuxt
artifacts.clean: delete the directory; Nuxt has no dedicated project clean command

artifacts.name: .turbo
artifacts.clean: npx turbo clean, or delete the directory

artifacts.name: .parcel-cache
artifacts.clean: delete the directory (Parcel rebuilds its cache)

artifacts.name: .svelte-kit
artifacts.clean: delete the directory; SvelteKit rebuilds it on the next build/dev run

artifacts.name: .angular
artifacts.clean: ng cache clean, or delete the directory

artifacts.name: .expo
artifacts.clean: npx expo start -c (clears the bundler cache), or delete the directory

artifacts.name: .nyc_output
artifacts.clean: delete the directory; nyc rebuilds it on the next run
